title: Quant profile validation engine: modular accuracy assessor and metric contracts
creator: Ava Chen
description: Implement a lightweight, extensible validation engine that ingests quantization profile metadata and runs task-aware accuracy assessments for FP8/INT8 rollouts. The engine must support: streaming token-level perplexity with sequence reweighting, an exam-style MMLU wrapper that maps prompt templates and few-shot seeds, sequence-constrained BLEU/ROUGE suited for long-form summarization outputs, and per-task fidelity checks (classification accuracy, top-k F1, regression RMSE) with configurable acceptance gates. The goal is a single binary that can be invoked in CI, in nightly batch jobs, and from the Console's rollout pipeline for automated gating. Keep runtime overhead low by reusing cached KV prefixes from calibration runs and by sampling stratified by sequence length and prompt template.
acceptance_criteria: Engine provides a stable CLI and Python SDK to execute a validation run given: model artifact, quant profile, and evaluation manifest
Perplexity calculation supports token streaming and returns both sequence-level and corpus-level perplexities with confidence intervals
MMLU wrapper runs standardized 57-subject suites with reproducible few-shot seeds and returns per-subject pass rates and aggregated accuracy
BLEU and ROUGE implementations are tolerant of tokenization shifts caused by quant-induced subtokenization changes and include an alignment heuristic
Validation outputs a machine-readable report that contains pass/fail per metric and a human-friendly summary for Console upload
Tooling integrates with rollout automation to block canaries if any P0 metric regresses beyond configured deltas
implementation_plan: Week 1: Define metric contract schema and lightweight report proto (JSON schema), prototype streaming perplexity algorithm
Week 2: Implement MMLU harness with deterministic seeding and template registry; build few-shot sampling utilities
Week 3: Implement BLEU/ROUGE wrappers with token-alignment corrections and long-sequence chunking
Week 4: Add per-task checkers (classification, token-generation, regression) and gate evaluation logic
Week 5: Integrate cached KV prefix usage into validation runner and add CLI/SDK surface
Week 6: Add Console uploader hooks; wire into canary gating flow and create rollout demo
test_plan: Unit tests for perplexity streaming with synthetic models and oracle distributions
Reproducibility tests for MMLU wrapper across 10 runs per seed
BLEU/ROUGE regression tests against golden outputs with perturbed tokenization scenarios
End-to-end smoke: run on a small fp8 quant profile and verify gates block on known-degraded model
Performance tests: measure validation runtime and KV cache hit rate on CI-sized shards
notes: Avoid reusing naming conventions from previous 'scorer' modules to keep this implementation conceptually distinct; we call the new component 'assessor' in docs
We intentionally expose both absolute metrics and delta-from-baseline in reports to support both gating and human review
Cache reuse: validation runner should accept a path to calibration artifacts (prefix caches) produced by the quant pipeline
Edge case: for models that change tokenization after quant conversion, include an alignment pass that maps tokens back to pre-quantization forms using edit-distance heuristics
